<thought>From the 13C NMR spectrum we have peaks at 168.60, 143.85, 130.30, 22.80, 21.35, and 19.20 ppm. Aromatic carbons appear in the ~110–160 ppm region. The peaks at 143.85 ppm and 130.30 ppm fall in this range, while the 168.60 ppm peak is more typical of a carbonyl carbon. Therefore the molecule contains two distinct aromatic carbon environments, indicating two aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>2</final_answer>
